verdict: Yes. Popcorn from Delhi pitched ready-to-eat popcorn on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Popcorn is a lighter snack than chips, and gourmet flavours sell well in quick commerce, cinemas and offices.
angle: Air-popped and gourmet popcorn in flavours like caramel, cheese and peri-peri appeals to buyers looking for lighter snacks. Popcorn is cheap to make but bulky, so packaging and freight costs matter.
